children.objective: Focus on reducing the hierarchical reduction’s work per launch and number of stages: explore multiple elements per thread or block, partial-sum layouts in scratch, and a complete device-side final stage. Treat the shared-memory reduction as a controlled starting point, not a restriction; where useful, compare a faster intra-block method or a combined variant with T2’s approach. Vary tile sizes without assuming fewer CTAs or stages are always faster, and measure the full run. Handle tails and do not assume vector-load alignment that the interface does not guarantee. Preserve exactness for all valid inputs, using wider or unsigned modulo-2^32 intermediates if needed.
children.subject: Granularité des blocs et nombre d’étapes de la réduction hiérarchique

children.objective: Make intra-block reduction the main comparison: test a warp/shuffle method or permitted CUB BlockReduce against the current shared-memory tree, with matched block workload and end-to-end timings. The baseline’s 128-thread, one-element-per-thread configuration is a useful control, not a restriction; include a larger-work-per-block or hierarchical variant where useful to test interaction with T1 and whether the local improvement combines. Preserve exactness even if intermediate subsets can exceed int32, and validate tails and all required sizes.
children.subject: Réduction intra-bloc par warp ou primitive CUB

children.objective: Compare staged partial-sum finalization with the alternative of explicitly zeroing output and atomically accumulating each block’s result. Include both launches in end-to-end timings; where possible, match the first-stage chunking and block reduction to a staged candidate so the finalization strategy is the contrast. Explore contention and chunk-size tradeoffs without assuming atomics win, and allow other correctness-preserving variants. Use unsigned modulo-2^32 or wider intermediates so cancellation cannot make intermediate signed overflow incorrect. Preserve stream ordering and buffer bounds; check n=0 only if the contract admits it.
children.subject: Finalisation atomique après initialisation explicite de la sortie
